snippet.title: ⚔ Kings Do Not Fall – Official Launch Trailer ⚔
snippet.description:
⚔ Kings Do Not Fall – Official Launch Trailer ⚔

🔥 Now Available on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4231970/Kings_Do_Not_Fall/

Step into the boots of King Alden and fight to restore balance in a world consumed by darkness.

Inspired by the golden age of 90s arcade games, *Kings Do Not Fall* is a retro-style beat ’em up where you battle through hordes of enemies, master powerful combos, and face epic bosses across six handcrafted levels.

Stand your ground. Fight through the horde. Prove that kings do not fall.

🎮 Key Features:
• Classic arcade beat ’em up gameplay
• 6 levels with unique bosses
• Dozens of enemies (goblins, orcs, undead, and more)
• Combos, weapons, and powerful super attacks
• CRT filter for authentic retro feel
• Steam achievements and leaderboard

💬 Follow & Wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4231970/Kings_Do_Not_Fall/

#BeatEmUp #IndieGame #RetroGaming #SteamGame #Arcade #IndieDev #Gaming

* About the creator
Carlo Perconti, born in 1966, is a veteran game developer. Alongside his longtime collaborator and friend Lyes Belaidouni, he worked as the programmer on games such as Legend and Iron Commando on Super Nintendo, Burning Road on Sony PlayStation, and Soulfighter on Sega Dreamcast, among many others.
Now, more than three decades after his first beat ’em up (Legend), he returns to the roots of the genre. Kings Do Not Fall is a modern yet old-school beat ’em up, a new game that looks and plays like a classic 1990s title, created as a tribute to fans of the genre.  

* About HyperDevbox
Based in Tokyo and founded in 2005 by CEO Carlo Perconti, HyperDevbox is a multi platform developer and publisher dedicated to delivering fun, high quality, and technically advanced games. From retro classics to modern shooters, our titles span PC, smartphones, tablets, and consoles.

Website: 
http://www.hyperdevbox.com

Facebook: 
http://www.facebook.com/hyperdevbox
________________________________________

HyperDevbox - “Bringing back the glory of retro gaming—one beat at a time.”
